prompt: Load the installed Vibe Builder Skill and references. Create a NEW Life XP habit RPG App from scratch; do not reuse life-xp-demo or its data. Use slug life-xp-autonomous-<numeric suffix of {{MARKER}}> and /workspace/<slug>; confirm absent first. Read project_contract. Chinese phone UI: dark navy/mint, original SVG avatar/icon, Today and History tabs, animated XP bar and level-up celebration. Start XP/history empty. Default habits: water +10 XP, exercise +30, reading +20. Add habit with name and positive XP. Level=1+floor(totalXP/50). SQLite is source of truth; UNIQUE(habit_id,day) enforces one check-in per local day. Disable completed/in-flight actions; show loading/errors; update only after saved. Persist habits, check-ins and progress across reopening. History must show real local date, habit, XP, daily/cumulative totals and correct level milestones. All assets local; schema_path required; Skill frontmatter name equals the actual slug. Expose business tools, follow actual connector pagination contract, validate and publish. Own testing and repair without supervisor step-by-step prompts. Import production calculation code in executable tests; cover duplicates, invalid then valid input, local midnight/date rollover, multi-day history, multi-level rewards and over 500 rows using isolated fixtures, never fake production history. Call published business tools and execute available real UI/reopen checks. Preserve commands, exit codes and actual results in test-results. Fix failures and rerun; clearly report blocked capabilities. Publishing or copied-formula tests do not prove acceptance. Do not stop at a plan.
